All panelists agree: with 240 participants per arm, the peloxatril responder rate was 96/240 = 40%, and the placebo responder rate was 60/240 = 25%. The absolute difference is 15 percentage points.

Answer: Peloxatril 40% (96/240), placebo 25% (60/240); absolute difference 15 percentage points.

Answer: Fiscal-2025 revenue was $214 million; operating margin was 9.4%.
